page_title: LEN 4-0 NAN | Lens v Nantes 28/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' The match has just finished.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
89' 4 - 0 Goal! Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 4:0.
86' Adson (Nantes) fires the ball on goal but sends it into orbit.
85' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
85' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) steps up and sends the free kick straight into the defensive wall. Lens force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
84' Franck Haise decides to make a substitution. Florian Sotoca will be replaced by Oscar Cortes (Lens).
83' Jean-Kevin Duverne (Nantes) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
81' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Moussa Sissoko (Nantes) is coming onto the pitch as Samuel Moutoussamy cannot continue after picking up an injury.
81' It is time for a substitution. Jaouen Hadjam (Nantes) is on for Quentin Merlin.
80' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) shows his brilliant passing ability after picking out Ruben Aguilar with a fine lofted pass.
78' Franck Haise has decided to make a change. Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) replaces Andy Diouf.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Angelo Fulgini (Lens) comes onto the pitch for Adrien Thomasson.
77' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) unleashes a shot from a mid-range free kick that goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.
76' Nantes have a goal-scoring opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
76' Adson (Nantes) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
72' 3 - 0 Goal! Florian Sotoca (Lens) puts the ball into the bottom right corner past the outstretched arm of Alban Lafont.
72' Substitution. Adson (Nantes) replaces Marcus Coco.
71' Florian Sotoca (Lens) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
71' Lens are awarded a penalty!
71' Surely that's handball by one of the Nantes players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
69' Franck Haise has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Morgan Guilavogui (Lens) replacing Elye Wahi.
69' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Deiver Machado walks off the pitch to be replaced by Massadio Haidara (Lens).
68' Elye Wahi (Lens) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
68' Eray Comert (Nantes) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
65' Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
64' Jonathan Gradit (Lens) commits a rough foul. Pierre Gaillouste stops the game and makes a call.
61' He should have scored! Elye Wahi (Lens) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the middle of the goal is pretty weak and Alban Lafont makes an easy save.
60' Pierre Aristouy prepares a substitution. Matthis Abline is replaced by Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes).
60' Here comes a substitution. Kader Bamba (Nantes) is brought on as a substitute for Moses Simon.
58' 2 - 0 Goal! Florian Sotoca plays a short, square pass into the path of Facundo Medina (Lens), who bends a shot straight into the right side of the goal to make it 2:0. Fabulous goal!
57' A crossfield pass from Samuel Moutoussamy (Nantes) fails to find any of his teammates.
55' The ball is cleared after Adrien Thomasson (Lens) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
55' Jean-Kevin Duverne (Nantes) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
53' Jean-Kevin Duverne (Nantes) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
53' Lens keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
49' Lens take a short corner kick.
47' Elye Wahi (Lens) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+1' Samuel Moutoussamy (Nantes) plays a through ball but overhits it.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Deiver Machado (Lens) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. It's a throw-in for Nantes.
40' Elye Wahi (Lens) doesn't hesitate to shoot inside the box after a neat pass from Ruben Aguilar. It's a good effort but just misses the left post.
37' A pass by Andy Diouf (Lens) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
37' Quentin Merlin (Nantes) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
36' Samuel Moutoussamy (Nantes) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot a whisker wide of the left post. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better!
35' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Lens.
32' What a chance that is! Moses Simon swings the ball into the box, and Matthis Abline (Nantes) gets in front of his man and powers his header just wide of the right post.
27' 1 - 0 Florian Sotoca (Lens) slots the penalty home.
26' Florian Sotoca (Lens) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
26' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!
25' Referee Pierre Gaillouste makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
25' One of the Lens players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
25' The corner is swung in but Lens can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
22' The corner from Florent Mollet (Nantes) is intercepted by the defence.
21' Nantes seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
17' Florian Sotoca (Lens) releases Ruben Aguilar, who latched on to his perfect through pass and can continue with his team's attack.
15' Andy Diouf (Lens) takes the corner with a short pass.
11' A rebound falls kindly for Samuel Moutoussamy (Nantes), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty!
9' Marcus Coco (Nantes) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Pierre Gaillouste blows his whistle for a foul.
5' Florian Sotoca (Lens) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
3' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Nantes will have the kick-off.
Pierre Gaillouste will supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
